name: 28 · Passive voice · Normal
description: 50 preguntas normales sobre passive voice y estructuras causativas en contextos SOC y de comunicación con clientes.

questions.question: All customer calls ___ for quality purposes.
questions.explanation: El present simple passive se forma con am/is/are + participio. Calls es plural, por eso usamos are recorded.
questions.translation: Todas las llamadas con clientes se graban con fines de calidad.

questions.question: The weekly overview ___ by the team lead every Friday.
questions.explanation: Para una rutina en pasiva usamos present simple passive: is + reviewed. El sujeto, overview, es singular.
questions.translation: El responsable del equipo revisa el resumen semanal todos los viernes.

questions.question: The customer ___ about the delay yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: Yesterday afternoon exige pasado; la pasiva singular se forma con was + participio: was notified.
questions.translation: Se informó al cliente del retraso ayer por la tarde.

questions.question: Several alerts ___ automatically when the test began.
questions.explanation: En past simple passive con sujeto plural usamos were + participio: were generated.
questions.translation: Se generaron varias alertas automáticamente cuando comenzó la prueba.

questions.question: Confidential attachments ___ on personal devices.
questions.explanation: La negativa pasiva en presente usa am/is/are + not + participio. Attachments exige are.
questions.translation: Los archivos adjuntos confidenciales no se almacenan en dispositivos personales.

questions.question: ___ the account locked after the customer call?
questions.explanation: En una pregunta pasiva en past simple colocamos was/were antes del sujeto: Was the account locked...?
questions.translation: ¿Se bloqueó la cuenta después de la llamada con el cliente?

questions.question: Choose the correct passive version of “The night shift prepared the handover.”
options: The handover prepared by the night shift.
The handover was prepare by the night shift.
The night shift was prepared the handover.
The handover was prepared by the night shift.
questions.explanation: El objeto de la activa pasa a sujeto y usamos was + participio: was prepared.
questions.translation: El traspaso fue preparado por el turno de noche.

questions.question: These access requests ___ by a separate team.
questions.explanation: Requests es plural; el present simple passive correcto es are handled.
questions.translation: Estas solicitudes de acceso las gestiona otro equipo.

questions.question: The first draft ___ by Elena before the meeting.
questions.explanation: El participio de write es written; en pasado pasivo singular usamos was written.
questions.translation: El primer borrador fue redactado por Elena antes de la reunión.

questions.question: The summary ___ by the morning shift and sent at noon.
questions.explanation: El sujeto singular summary recibe la acción, así que usamos was + participio.
questions.translation: El resumen fue preparado por el turno de mañana y enviado al mediodía.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: The unusual activity ___ at the moment.
questions.explanation: El present continuous passive se forma con am/is/are being + participio: is being investigated.
questions.translation: La actividad inusual se está investigando en este momento.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: The open cases ___ when the customer joined the call.
questions.explanation: Para una acción pasiva en curso en un momento pasado usamos was/were being + participio.
questions.translation: Los casos abiertos se estaban revisando cuando el cliente se unió a la llamada.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: The revised report ___ to the customer already.
questions.explanation: El present perfect passive se forma con has/have been + participio: has been sent.
questions.translation: El informe revisado ya se ha enviado al cliente.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: By the time I checked the queue, the ticket ___ .
questions.explanation: El past perfect passive usa had been + participio y marca una acción anterior a otra acción pasada.
questions.translation: Cuando comprobé la cola, el ticket ya se había cerrado.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: The remaining questions ___ during tomorrow’s call.
questions.explanation: El future passive se forma con will be + participio: will be discussed.
questions.translation: Las preguntas restantes se tratarán durante la llamada de mañana.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: The contact list ___ before the next exercise.
questions.explanation: La pasiva con be going to se forma con am/is/are going to be + participio.
questions.translation: La lista de contactos se actualizará antes del próximo ejercicio.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: Every customer-facing message ___ before it is sent.
questions.explanation: La pasiva con modal usa modal + be + participio: must be approved.
questions.translation: Todos los mensajes destinados al cliente deben aprobarse antes de enviarse.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: The internal notes ___ outside the approved group.
questions.explanation: La negativa pasiva con modal se forma con modal + not + be + participio.
questions.translation: Las notas internas no deberían compartirse fuera del grupo autorizado.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: The misunderstanding ___ with a clearer subject line.
questions.explanation: Para una posibilidad pasiva no realizada en el pasado usamos could have been + participio.
questions.translation: El malentendido podría haberse evitado con un asunto más claro.

questions.topic: Continuous, perfect, future and modal passive
questions.question: The final update ___ if the approval arrives late.
questions.explanation: La pasiva con may se forma con may be + participio: may be delayed.
questions.translation: La actualización final podría retrasarse si la aprobación llega tarde.

questions.question: When ___ the first notification sent?
questions.explanation: En una pregunta pasiva en pasado con sujeto singular usamos was antes del sujeto.
questions.translation: ¿Cuándo se envió la primera notificación?

questions.question: ___ the latest version been approved yet?
questions.explanation: El present perfect passive interrogativo empieza con has/have: Has ... been approved?
questions.translation: ¿Se ha aprobado ya la última versión?

questions.question: Why ___ the customer informed about the new time?
questions.explanation: La pregunta se refiere a una omisión pasada y el sujeto es singular: Why wasn’t ... informed?
questions.translation: ¿Por qué no se informó al cliente de la nueva hora?

questions.question: Choose the natural question asking about the writer of the report.
options: Who did the report write by?
Who was written the report by?
Who was the report written by?
By who the report was written?
questions.explanation: En la pregunta pasiva informal usamos Who + was + sujeto + participio + by.
questions.translation: ¿Quién redactó el informe?

questions.question: ___ was the exception approved?
questions.explanation: En registro formal, la preposición va delante de whom: By whom was...?
questions.translation: ¿Quién aprobó la excepción?

questions.question: The earlier email address ___ in the final message.
questions.explanation: La negativa en past simple passive se forma con was/were not + participio.
questions.translation: La dirección de correo anterior no se incluyó en el mensaje final.

questions.question: This template ___ for a customer report before.
questions.explanation: En present perfect passive, never va normalmente entre has y been: has never been used.
questions.translation: Esta plantilla nunca se ha utilizado antes para un informe de cliente.

questions.question: ___ the client told that the meeting had moved?
questions.explanation: La estructura pasiva interrogativa en pasado es Was + sujeto + participio.
questions.translation: ¿Se informó al cliente de que la reunión había cambiado de hora?

questions.question: How many requests ___ during the morning shift?
questions.explanation: Requests es plural y recibe la acción; usamos were + participio.
questions.translation: ¿Cuántas solicitudes se recibieron durante el turno de mañana?

questions.question: Where ___ the recording be stored after the call?
questions.explanation: La pregunta en future passive se forma con will + sujeto + be + participio.
questions.translation: ¿Dónde se almacenará la grabación después de la llamada?

questions.question: We should have the final report ___ before sending it.
questions.explanation: Have something done se forma con have + objeto + participio: have the report proofread.
questions.translation: Deberíamos hacer que revisaran el informe final antes de enviarlo.

questions.question: The user needs to get the password ___ before the next login.
questions.explanation: Get something done usa get + objeto + participio. Reset tiene la misma forma como infinitivo y participio.
questions.translation: El usuario necesita que le restablezcan la contraseña antes del próximo inicio de sesión.

questions.question: We had the slides ___ after the rehearsal.
questions.explanation: En pasado, had + objeto + participio indica que otra persona realizó el trabajo.
questions.translation: Hicimos que actualizaran las diapositivas después del ensayo.

questions.question: The coordinator is having the audio ___ before the webinar.
questions.explanation: La estructura continua es is having + objeto + participio: is having the audio checked.
questions.translation: La coordinadora está haciendo que comprueben el audio antes del seminario web.

questions.question: We’ll have the attachment ___ before it leaves the approved environment.
questions.explanation: Tras have + objeto usamos el participio para indicar que se encarga la acción a otra persona o servicio.
questions.translation: Haremos que cifren el archivo adjunto antes de que salga del entorno autorizado.

questions.question: ___ you have the document translated before the call?
questions.explanation: La pregunta en past simple con have something done usa did + sujeto + have + objeto + participio.
questions.translation: ¿Hiciste traducir el documento antes de la llamada?

questions.question: The customer wants to get the notification settings ___ .
questions.explanation: Get + objeto + participio expresa que se solicita o consigue que otra persona haga el cambio.
questions.translation: El cliente quiere que le cambien la configuración de las notificaciones.

questions.question: She didn’t design the diagram herself; she had it ___ by a colleague.
questions.explanation: Had it created indica que otra persona creó el diagrama; created es el participio.
questions.translation: No diseñó ella misma el diagrama; hizo que un compañero lo creara.

questions.question: Choose the sentence meaning that another person checked our wording.
questions.explanation: Have + objeto + participio expresa causativa: encargamos a otra persona la revisión.
questions.translation: Hicimos que revisaran nuestra redacción.

questions.question: They finally got their account ___ after contacting support.
questions.explanation: Got + objeto + participio indica que consiguieron que se realizara la acción.
questions.translation: Finalmente consiguieron que les restauraran la cuenta tras contactar con soporte.

questions.question: Choose the correct passive version of “The SOC sent the customer a short update.”
options: The customer was sent a short update by the SOC.
The customer sent a short update by the SOC.
The customer was send a short update by the SOC.
A short update was sent the customer by the SOC.
questions.explanation: Con verbos de doble objeto, el receptor puede pasar a sujeto: The customer was sent... El participio es sent.
questions.translation: El SOC envió al cliente una breve actualización.

questions.question: People expect that the call will finish by noon. Choose the formal passive equivalent.
options: It expects that the call will finish by noon.
It is expect that the call will finish by noon.
It is expected that the call will finish by noon.
The call is expected that will finish by noon.
questions.explanation: La pasiva impersonal se forma con It + be + participio + that: It is expected that...
questions.translation: Se espera que la llamada termine antes del mediodía.

questions.question: People believe that the account is inactive. Choose the correct passive form.
options: The account believes to be inactive.
The account is believed to be inactive.
The account is believe being inactive.
The account is believed that inactive.
questions.explanation: Con believe podemos usar sujeto + be + participio + to-infinitive: is believed to be.
questions.translation: Se cree que la cuenta está inactiva.

questions.question: People say that the alert appeared at midnight. Choose the form that reports the earlier event.
options: The alert is said to appear at midnight yesterday.
The alert says to have appeared at midnight.
The alert is said to have appeared at midnight.
The alert is said having appeared at midnight.
questions.explanation: Para una acción anterior al momento de informar usamos passive reporting verb + to have + participio.
questions.translation: Se dice que la alerta apareció a medianoche.

questions.question: The introduction needs ___ before the report is sent.
questions.explanation: Tras need, la forma pasiva con infinitivo es to be + participio: needs to be revised.
questions.translation: La introducción debe revisarse antes de enviar el informe.

questions.question: The customer appreciated ___ before the maintenance began.
questions.explanation: Después de appreciated usamos gerundio; en pasiva, being + participio: being contacted.
questions.translation: El cliente agradeció que se contactara con él antes de que comenzara el mantenimiento.

questions.question: The file was removed without anyone ___ to do it.
questions.explanation: Después de without usamos gerundio; la forma pasiva es being asked.
questions.translation: El archivo se eliminó sin que se pidiera a nadie que lo hiciera.

questions.question: In the active sentence they made us wait. Choose the correct passive form.
questions.explanation: Make lleva infinitivo sin to en activa, pero en pasiva recupera to: were made to wait.
questions.translation: Nos hicieron esperar.

questions.question: Choose the natural passive equivalent of “They let the client join early.”
options: The client was let to join early.
The client was allowed join early.
The client let be joined early.
The client was allowed to join early.
questions.explanation: La pasiva habitual de let se expresa con be allowed to + infinitivo.
questions.translation: Se permitió al cliente conectarse antes.

questions.question: Investigators consider that the incident has been resolved. Choose the formal passive equivalent.
options: The incident considers to be resolved.
The incident is considered to have been resolved.
The incident is considered having resolved.
The incident is consider to have been resolved.
questions.explanation: La estructura formal usa is considered + perfect infinitive passive: to have been resolved.
questions.translation: Se considera que el incidente se ha resuelto.
